rationale: The evidence supports a real supplier-document workflow and paid PPWR work but not this candidate's buyers, rights, distribution or subscription economics. The redesign makes the critical workflow obtainable through a specific customer agreement, replaces supplier/referral dependence with customer-routed requests and direct outbound, and retains a customer-upload-only paid fallback. Because no agreement is signed, control honestly remains unknown. The service model is economically coherent as a bounded prepaid test, but its lower 45-65% planning margin, CAC recovery, founder capacity and renewal require paid validation.

structural_change.control_instrument: Proposed, unsigned 12-month workflow-integration agreement plus data-processing schedule authorizing a defined evidence-request queue, customer-specific retention and audit logging; no cross-customer benchmark right is presumed.
structural_change.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own the direct brand contract and service relationship; each brand would retain its supplier relationships, source-document ownership and approval authority.
structural_change.dependency_change: Removes launch dependence on a proprietary shared dataset, voluntary supplier relationships and unsigned referral channels. It replaces them with customer-authorized procurement routing under an account-level agreement; if refused, the paid customer-upload-only baseline is deliverable without supplier integration.
structural_change.distribution_instrument: Founder-controlled direct outbound and direct customer service agreement; optional future nonexclusive written referral agreements are additive and are not represented as present access.
structural_change.fully_loaded_economic_effects: Changes the model from a presumed 75-85% subscription margin to a labor-bearing productized service targeting an unvalidated 45-65% contribution margin. Setup is 50% prepaid, retainers are quarterly prepaid, excess work and external tests are separately funded, planned CAC is 4,000-12,000 PLN, initial delivery is 40-100 hours, ongoing work is 8-20 hours monthly, and allocated compliance/security overhead is planned at 6,000-15,000 PLN monthly. These ranges require pilot time sheets, invoices, conversion and retention data.
structural_change.incumbent_response_defensibility: Incumbents are likely to bundle the workflow and low-price tools will undercut storage. The defensible wedge is faster bounded implementation and accountable exception closure inside the customer's process, but it is replaceable and no durable moat is claimed.
